_meta.scope: Deterministic pattern surface for means-access rehearsal phrasing: first-person counting / checking / getting-out / keeping / collecting of {pills, medication, tablets, blades, rope}, with proximity riders (just to know they're there / just in case / so I have them). Zero-affect behavioral-sign class: no SI verb, no distress vocabulary, so S1/S3 never see it. Fires as an S1 crisis_flag so the existing safety_check -> _route_after_safety escalate path (and T2 via the s1_any tier rule) applies on EVERY turn, including mid-skill skill_continuation turns (safety_check is the graph entry node and reads raw input).
_meta.counter_direction: Explicitly excluded (FP-rich, the reason this needs the clinician signature): disposal ('threw out my old pills', 'got rid of the blades'), routine adherence ('counted out my pills for the week', refill / prescription / pill-organizer phrasings, suppressed by FPE-MA-001 and the counted-out lookahead), third-party custody ('my mom keeps my medication for me', excluded by the first-person anchor).
_meta.vocabulary_ownership: SIGNED 2026-08-19 (record: 2026-08-19-vee-approval-record-signature-sheet.md, item 1). Class-level signature per the portability clause: the signed object is the disposition (means-access rehearsal escalates); this pattern set is the current implementation and the permanent fixture set. Vocabulary remains clinician-owned; AR slots stay PROPOSED-inactive pending native authoring.

rules.description: PROPOSED, awaiting Vee signature 2026-08-25, packet item 1. Means-access rehearsal, verb class: first-person counting / checking / getting-out of {pills, medication, tablets, blades, rope}. Pattern 1: i + count/check/take-out verb then means noun (counted-out is excluded by lookahead: 'counted out my pills for the week' is adherence, a signed must-NOT-fire). Pattern 2: i + got/took the means noun out (means-before-out order; 'out of' excluded so 'got out of the house' cannot bridge to a later means mention). Pattern 3: i ... means noun ... and counted/checked them/each/every (elided-subject second clause, MSK-02 shape). No negation_check: over-detection is the safe posture on the crisis path (SK-EN-006 precedent), and the negation classes here ('I have not counted them') are for Vee to rule on.

PROPOSED, awaiting Vee signature 2026-08-25, packet item 1. Means-access rehearsal, keeping/collecting class: fires ONLY with a proximity rider (just in case / just to know they're there / so I have them / if I need them), because bare first-person keeping of medication is ordinary adherence. Pattern 1: i + keep/collect verb then means noun then rider. Pattern 2: means noun then rider across a sentence boundary (rehearsal framing detached from the verb, 'my pills are still in the drawer. just to know they're there'), riders restricted to the unambiguous they're-there / so-i-have-them forms. Third-party custody ('my mom keeps my medication for me') is excluded by the first-person anchor before the verb.

\b(?:pills?|medications?|tablets?|blades?|rope)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:just to know (?:they(?:'re| are)|it(?:'s| is)) there|so (?:that )?i have them|so (?:that )?i know (?:they(?:'re| are)|it(?:'s| is)) (?:there|here|still there))

rules.description: PROPOSED, awaiting Vee signature 2026-08-25, packet item 1. Adherence/logistics suppression for the means-access surface (span-scoped, engine _apply_suppressions semantics): a means mention bound to organizer / for-the-week / refill / prescription / pharmacy / as-prescribed context suppresses ONLY the overlapping means_access_rehearsal match. Suppresses nothing outside its own span; si_explicit / si_passive / si_method are deliberately NOT in the suppresses list, so this can never soften the signed S1 surfaces.
